info.name: Cars API
info.description: Requests for Cars.API. Run the API and set the baseUrl variable to the server address. Run the Account and Cars folders in order: POST Login Admin saves the JWT in adminToken (used by the Cars folder) and POST Create Car saves the new car id in carId. The 'Account - Email (manual)' folder needs SMTP and tokens copied from Mailtrap.
